oai_qdc:qualifieddc.dc:title: Mr. Frederick F. Simms, circa 2000
oai_qdc:qualifieddc.dc:description: A reprinted picture of Mr. Frederick F. Simms, as shown in 1912, followed by biographical notes. Mr. Frederick F. Simms was one of Southern University's Founders and the first individual to receive a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Arts from the institution.
